en_title: Street Fighter Tops the Box Office With $51 Million Opening Weekend Amid Lackluster Reviews
cn_title: 《街头霸王》口碑平平，票房夺冠
subtitle: 还不算完胜
opus_summary: 《街头霸王》首周末登顶全球票房榜，但影评人评价平平，IGN给出6分。观众反响相对积极，烂番茄观众好评率达79%，后续几周的票房表现将考验影片能否争取到续集。

paragraphs.en: Capcom's Street Fighter movie spun up $51.1 million in its opening weekend, securing its place atop the global box office despite some not-so-great reviews.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空游戏改编电影《街头霸王》上映首周末斩获5,110万美元(约合人民币3亿元)，尽管影评反响不佳，仍登顶全球票房榜。

paragraphs.en: Ryu (Andrew Koji), Ken (Noah Centineo), and the rest of the film's massive cast grappled with an estimated $31 million domestically and $20.1 million internationally in its theatrical debut. That's a figure that landed it a comfortable first place worldwide, even if it's not a perfect victory across the board.
paragraphs.cn: 隆（Andrew Koji饰）、肯（Noah Centineo饰）以及片中其他众多角色在首周末合力拿下约3,100万美元(约合人民币2亿元)的北美票房和2,010万美元(约合人民币1亿元)的海外票房。这一成绩让影片稳居全球票房榜首，尽管它还算不上全面告捷。

paragraphs.en: As audiences turned up for performances – including Callina Liang's Chun-Li, David Dastmalchian's M. Bison, and Jason Momoa's Blanka – not everyone was so happy with how director Kitao Sakurai brought Capcom's classic fighting game franchise to the big screen. In its first few days in the public's gaze, Street Fighter has amassed a critics' score of 44 on IMDb and 41% on Rotten Tomatoes . IGN gave it a 6/10 .
paragraphs.cn: 观众走进影院，欣赏Callina Liang饰演的春丽、David Dastmalchian饰演的维加和杰森·莫玛饰演的布兰卡等角色，但并非所有人都满意导演Kitao Sakurai将卡普空经典格斗游戏系列搬上大银幕的方式。《街头霸王》上映头几天，IMDb影评人评分为44分，烂番茄影评人好评率为41%。IGN给出了6分的评价，满分10分。

paragraphs.en: That's serviceable as far as gaming adaptations go and sub-par in the grand scheme. Generally, fans are feeling pretty positive about what they've seen thanks to some crisp animation and fight sequences. " Dumb fun " is one phrase floating around for the film, which doesn't seem to be for everyone but has still pulled in 79% positivity from audiences, according to Rotten Tomatoes.
paragraphs.cn: 放在游戏改编作品中，这样的评价尚可接受，但放眼所有电影，就低于平均水准了。总体而言，得益于干净利落的动画和打斗场面，粉丝对影片的观感相当积极。「无脑但好玩」是流传的评价之一。这部电影似乎并不适合所有人，但据烂番茄数据，观众好评率仍达到了79%。

paragraphs.en: For comparison (and because Street Fighter actor Andrew Schulz has it on everyone's minds ), the 2021 Mortal Kombat movie earned $22.5 million domestically in its post-lockdown-era debut . Mortal Kombat 2 , which continued that story earlier this year, opened to $63 million globally, coming in second place behind The Devil Wears Prada 2.
paragraphs.cn: 作为对比——也是因为《街头霸王》演员Andrew Schulz让大家都想起了这部电影——2021年的《真人快打》在疫情封锁结束后上映，首周末北美票房为2,250万美元(约合人民币2亿元)。今年早些时候上映、延续前作故事的《真人快打2》，首周末全球票房为6,300万美元(约合人民币4亿元)，位居《穿普拉达的女王2》之后，排名第二。

paragraphs.en: That gives Mortal Kombat the edge over its Capcom competitor in terms of direct box office performance worldwide as the teams behind both projects tease ideas for a crossover . The real test for Street Fighter will be its performance in the weeks ahead. Paramount, Legendary, and Capcom made the adaptation with a production budget of $82 million, according to Deadline . We're not quite at that number yet, and if word of those bad reviews spreads too far, the video game movie's fight for a sequel might be more of an uphill battle than expected.
paragraphs.cn: 直接比较全球票房表现，《真人快打》由此领先于卡普空的这位对手，而两部影片的幕后团队也都在透露联动的构想。《街头霸王》真正的考验将是未来几周的票房表现。据Deadline报道，派拉蒙、传奇影业和卡普空为这部改编电影投入了8,200万美元(约合人民币5亿元)的制作预算。目前票房还没达到这一数字；如果差评传播得太广，这部游戏改编电影争取续集的道路，可能会比预想中更加艰难。

paragraphs.en: While Street Fighter takes the top box office spot, also in theaters this weekend is Nathan Fielder's You Can See Everything . A mind-bending look into the life of controversial Theranos creator Elizabeth Holmes and her partner, Billy Evans, the dark-comedy documentary has enraptured moviegoers with $15 million domestically.
paragraphs.cn: 《街头霸王》登顶票房榜的同时，Nathan Fielder的《You Can See Everything》也于本周末在影院上映。这部黑色喜剧纪录片以令人烧脑的方式，审视了备受争议的Theranos创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯及其伴侣Billy Evans的生活。影片令观众着迷，在北美收获了1,500万美元(约合人民币1亿元)票房。

paragraphs.en: That's a number that puts it well below the wide appeal garnered by Street Fighter, but considering the three-hour Fielder doc opened to just 855 theaters compared to the video game movie's 3,575, it's hard not to see You Can See Everything as a more impressive success story. Its production budget reportedly totaled less than $10 million, with its marketing budget also said to be around that same number.
paragraphs.cn: 这一数字远不及受众广泛的《街头霸王》，但考虑到Fielder这部长达三小时的纪录片首映时仅在855家影院上映，而那部游戏改编电影的开画影院数为3,575家，很难不觉得《You Can See Everything》的成功更令人瞩目。据报道，该片的制作预算不到1,000万美元(约合人民币6690万元)，宣发预算据称也在1,000万美元(约合人民币6690万元)左右(约合人民币金额待核实)。

paragraphs.en: Reviews for the movie are showing incredible positivity, too, with movie reviewer social media platform Letterboxd boasting that You Can See Everything quickly emerged as its highest-rated feature film. IGN's review returned a "Masterpiece" rating of 10/10 . We called it "a jaw-dropping, intimate investigative doc" that "finds TV host Nathan Fielder searching the deep-blue eyes of Silicon Valley scammer Elizabeth Holmes for mysterious answers."
paragraphs.cn: 这部电影的影评也好评如潮。影迷社交平台Letterboxd自豪地表示，《You Can See Everything》迅速成为平台上评分最高的长片。IGN为本片打出了10分满分，评价为「杰作」。我们称其为「一部令人惊叹、视角私密的调查纪录片」，片中「电视主持人Nathan Fielder凝视着硅谷骗子伊丽莎白·霍姆斯深蓝色的双眼，试图寻找神秘的答案」。

paragraphs.en: Fielder's latest is only available as a limited release for now. The plan is for it to get a much wider release in the near future, with one Deadline source saying, "Who knows where this will go."
paragraphs.cn: Fielder的最新作品目前仅小规模上映，计划在不久后大幅扩大上映范围。Deadline的一位消息人士表示：「谁知道接下来会发展成什么样呢。」

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in theaters, moviegoers have had the opportunity to watch two Capcom adaptations as Resident Evil continues its successful run. While star Austin Abrams rides that wave of success, his other picture, Whalefall , which debuted this weekend, only managed to wash up $17.5 million on its $60 million budget.
paragraphs.cn: 影院方面，随着《生化危机》继续保持亮眼表现，观众已有两部卡普空游戏改编电影可看。主演Austin Abrams凭借《生化危机》收获成功，但他另一部于本周末上映的电影《Whalefall》表现不佳：影片预算为6,000万美元(约合人民币4亿元)，票房却仅有1,750万美元(约合人民币1亿元)。

paragraphs.en: For more on Street Fighter, you can read why we think it makes a mistake that Mortal Kombat already learned from . You can also see our breakdown of its ending and our list of the best movies of the year .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《街头霸王》的相关内容，可以阅读我们的文章，了解为何我们认为它犯了一个《真人快打》已经吸取教训的错误。你也可以查看我们对影片结局的解析，以及我们的年度最佳电影榜单。
